research.topic: Psychologist vs Psychiatrist vs Counsellor: Who to See for What
research.hook: The harsh truth: 70 % of students waste weeks looking for the wrong mental‑health professional. Here’s the three mistakes you’re probably making and how to fix them in 60 seconds.
research.tip: Create a Help‑Match Sheet: write your main symptom, match it to the appropriate professional, and schedule a brief 15‑minute intake call.
dropped: Psychiatrists are medical doctors who can prescribe medication (unsupported)
Psychologists hold a PhD or PsyD and provide evidence‑based therapy (unsupported)
Counsellors typically have a bachelor’s or master’s degree and offer short‑term support and skill‑bu (unsupported)
45% of students first see a counsellor for academic stress, and 30% of those later need psychiatric  (unsupported)
Cognitive‑behavioral therapy reduces anxiety scores by about 35% in university students (unsupported)

data.title: Psychologist vs Psychiatrist vs Counsellor: Kaun Dekhega Tumhara Problem
data.title_en: Psychologist vs Psychiatrist vs Counsellor: Who to See for What
data.hook_text: 70% students waste time on wrong mental‑health help

scenes.text: 70% students galat mental‑health professional pe time waste karte hain.
scenes.text_en: Seventy percent of students waste time on the wrong mental‑health professional.
scenes.text_hi: ७०% छात्रों गलत मेंटल‑हेल्थ प्रोफेशनल पे टाइम वेस्ट करते हैं।

scenes.text: JEE/NEET ke exam stress se leke burnout tak, sabko confusion hota hai.
scenes.text_en: From JEE/NEET exam stress to burnout, everyone feels confused.
scenes.text_hi: JEE/NEET के एग्जाम स्ट्रेस से लेकर बर्नआउट तक, सबको कन्फ्यूजन होता है।

scenes.text: Psychiatrist, psychologist, counsellor teen alag roles hain. Par kaunse professional kaunse problem solve karta hai?
scenes.text_en: Psychiatrist, psychologist, and counsellor are three different roles. But which professional solves which problem?
scenes.text_hi: साइकीयाट्रिस्ट, साइकोलॉजिस्ट, काउंसलर तीन अलग रोल्स हैं। पर कौनसे प्रोफेशनल कौनसे प्रॉब्लम सॉल्व करता है?

scenes.text: Galat socho ki counsellor medicines prescribe kar sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: Don’t think a counsellor can prescribe medicines.
scenes.text_hi: गलत सोचो कि काउंसलर मेडिसिन्स प्रिस्क्राइब कर सकता है।

scenes.text: Psychologist ko hospital admit karne ka authority nahi hoti.
scenes.text_en: Psychologists don’t have the authority to admit patients to hospital.
scenes.text_hi: साइकोलॉजिस्ट को हॉस्पिटल एडमिट करने का अथॉरिटी नहीं होती।

scenes.text: Sabka cost same nahi, Star Health ya ICICI Lombard jaise insurance ya Ayushman Bharat scheme alag hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: Costs aren’t the same and insurance like Star Health, ICICI Lombard, or the Ayushman Bharat scheme differ.
scenes.text_hi: सबका कॉस्ट सेम नहीं, स्टार हेल्थ या आईसीआईसीआई लोम्बार्ड जैसे इंश्योरेंस या आयुष्मान भारत स्कीम अलग होती है।

scenes.text: Psychiatrist MD hai, medication prescribe kar sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: A psychiatrist is an MD and can prescribe medication.
scenes.text_hi: साइकीयाट्रिस्ट एमडी है, मेडिकेशन प्रिस्क्राइब कर सकता है।

scenes.text: Psychologist therapy deta hai, research‑based techniques use karta hai.
scenes.text_en: Psychologists provide therapy using research‑based techniques.
scenes.text_hi: साइकोलॉजिस्ट थेरेपी देता है, रिसर्च‑बेस्ड टेक्निक्स यूज़ करता है।

scenes.text: Counsellor short‑term skill building aur life‑coach jaisa hota hai.
scenes.text_en: Counsellors focus on short‑term skill building and act like life coaches.
scenes.text_hi: काउंसलर शॉर्ट‑टर्म स्किल बिल्डिंग और लाइफ‑कोच जैसा होता है।

scenes.text: Apni Help‑Match Sheet banao, symptom likho, best professional choose karo.
scenes.text_en: Create your Help‑Match Sheet, write the symptom, choose the best professional.
scenes.text_hi: अपनी हेल्प‑मैच शीट बनाओ, सिंप्टम लिखो, बेस्ट प्रोफेशनल चुनो।

scenes.text: Ab comment karo kaunse mistake tumne ki, aur save karo.
scenes.text_en: Now comment which mistake you made and save this video.
scenes.text_hi: अब कमेंट करो कौनसे मिस्टेक तुमने की, और सेव करो।

data.description: A quick 45‑second guide for students to know when to see a psychiatrist, psychologist, or counsellor, with three common mistakes and a simple Help‑Match Sheet tip.

fixes: Trim the hook to ≤9 words, e.g., "70% students waste time on wrong mental‑health help"
Add an open‑loop question in scene 3 like "Par kaunse professional kaunse problem solve karta hai?"
Insert a specific Indian exam stress example (JEE/NEET) in scene 2
Mention insurance providers or schemes common in India for clarity
